milestones.outcome: A reviewer can identify and inspect a failed check from Overview, with truthful result identity, detail links and availability.
exit_criteria: The 16 passed, 1 failed, 7 skipped scenario exposes Branch Freshness and its supplied explanation inside the composed Overview.
Current check runs and commit statuses, repeated attempts and head/test-merge identity remain distinct; incomplete results never imply merge readiness.
Native detail controls and admitted link handoff pass the RFC acceptance, with relevant documentation reconciled.
milestones.boundary: An integrated check-inspection feature. Requirement classification may remain explicitly unknown until the next milestone; no reruns or repository execution.

milestones.outcome: Overview explains why merging is blocked and visibly names the users and code-owner teams whose reviews are still requested.
exit_criteria: Three provider-marked code-owner teams and ordinary pending users remain visible even when they have never commented or reviewed.
The composed blocked example shows applicable review requirements and check failures together without guessing remaining approvals, individual team obligations or auto-merge state.
Available details and true host/access limits are distinguished across the qualified provider paths, with native usability and the RFC acceptance verified.
milestones.boundary: A read-only merge-requirements and reviewer explanation, using server facts. No collaboration writes, merge operations or local CODEOWNERS evaluator.

milestones.outcome: Authored PRs awaiting review remain discoverable in the correct Home section, with the same waiting identities and blockers as Overview.
exit_criteria: Discovery, opening and returning Home preserve pending-review facts, including authored PRs enrolled only through Follow or an observer rule.
The mixed code-owner/check-failure example stays in Waiting on others, with the existing unread-activity precedence and truthful Quiet-items behavior.
Bounded background reads, freshness, restart, identity changes and ordinary Home controls satisfy the RFC; one final integrated public-path pass reconciles the complete pack.
milestones.boundary: Correct waiting facts, persistence, classification and native explanation under the existing section order. No enrollment expansion, automatic reminders or new notification category.
